title: UNREVIEWED PROTOTYPE - Womb with a View ANC comic panels

fieldUseRequirements: Before field use, an illustrator draws every panel from its visual brief in governance.json. No artwork exists; every frame shows a text placeholder today.

Before field use, a clinician checks every caption. Several captions in the source document are marked (verify) by the author, and two versions of some disagree; governance.json records which wording was taken and which was left out.

Before field use, the four panels whose subject is a governed danger-sign list or visit schedule stay pointers to the governed screen. Restoring the source document's own wording would create a second clinical source, and it already differs from the app's: it omits convulsions, which RW-G05 in docs/localization/RWANDA-LOCALIZATION.md flags as a gap in the governed screen itself.
Before field use, the whole pack is translated and read by named local speakers. English only today; Kinyarwanda is the next round.
Before field use, pretest the birth-spacing panel with women and husbands; the author notes it can touch religious and family sensitivities.

Before field use, confirm the first-hour breastfeeding and daily-supplement panels against the Rwanda ANC guideline: RW-G11 records that the bank has no such teaching today, so these panels would be the first and have no governed twin to agree with.
